description: Land Acquisition - Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2299/10 on dated 27.09.2022 Harispaththuwa D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is a corrigenda notice under Section 7 of The Land Acquisition Act, specifically correcting the date and time for a land acquisition proceeding. The entire content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters, including notification requirements for interested parties with rights or possessions in the land, compensation claims, and proceedings at the Divisional Secretary's Office. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition procedures and property rights.
